levels._comment: docs/features/hash-levels-eval.md (5a-2) TE-2: the expected `result.levels`, derived by hand from the spec's Data over the 69 items and 8 files above, never read back from a run; checked by crates/specengine-eval/tests/hash_levels_eval.rs, whose L-tags name the readings. Items: 66 with levels, 3 without (`broken_one`, `broken_two`, `tilde`); files: 6 with module levels, 2 without (`broken.rs`, `macro_error.rs`). An item index runs over every item in analysis order, broken ones too, and the neighbour edit and the rename touch broken items as any other (L1); every count covers items with levels; a percentage is one decimal over the items compared (66 hashed; 52 checked; 6 hashed files) (L2). `quote` kept: 50 of 66 under comment stripping (the first item under a leading `//!` block, every item of comments.rs), 10 of 52 checked under the neighbour edit (an edited item starting on the next non-blank line rewrites the `after` line), 16 of 59 renamed (L6). `body_bytes` by hand: 16 items at or above 64, 6 at or above 96, 3 at or above 124 (`summarize` 209, `weight_or_default` 201, `all_have_weight` 127; nearest below: `heavy_labels` 123), 2 at or above 160, none at 256; no two items of one kind at or above 64 share a `body`, so every `body_twins` is 0 and the 3 non-trivial items are `followable`. Skeleton groups: lib.rs's six plain `pub mod x;`, `inner` and `deepest`, `intact_before` and `intact_after`; the quotes of each group all differ. Not pinned, checked by rule in the test: `stable_pct.fmt_default.quote` and `stable_pct.fmt_contrast.quote` (rustfmt's version decides them; below 100.0, since any rustfmt rewrites unformatted.rs's `pub struct   Config{`) and `cost` (a timing).
